description: Crash repro (2026-10-02, camera-cycle baseline run 131502): t01 direct boot on i76.exe, F1 then F6 (PRESET_VIEW_4 = hood camera, transition 0x407500, per-frame 0x407680). The baseline run died with 0xC0000005 one frame after the callback changed to 0x407680, with the car coasting at 5 m/s. The watch thread logs the camera mode; the game surviving 10 s in the hood view is the check.
